faq.question: What is included in Amazon listing optimization?
faq.answer: Typical work covers keyword research, titles, bullets, descriptions, backend terms, and coordination with images or A+ content. Scope is set per ASIN priority during the free audit.

faq.question: How long before ranking changes appear?
faq.answer: Indexing and ranking response vary by category and competition. Some signals move within weeks; sustained ranking gains usually require ongoing optimization and sales velocity support. We do not publish a fixed percentage rank guarantee.

faq.question: Do you rewrite every listing at once?
faq.answer: We prioritize ASINs by revenue potential, inventory, and advertising plans so effort concentrates where commercial impact is highest.

faq.question: Will listing changes affect my PPC campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes, often positively when conversion improves. We coordinate with advertising so keyword targeting and listing language stay aligned.

faq.question: Do you handle A+ Content as part of listing SEO?
faq.answer: We coordinate A+ where Brand Registry access exists. Writing and design can be delivered through our content and visual teams.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support listing work across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do you measure listing optimization success?
faq.answer: We track organic ranking for priority terms, conversion rate, and sales contribution alongside advertising efficiency for the same ASINs.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are an ASIN priority review, findings call, then an optimization plan and implementation.
